purpose: Permanent character voice-casting registry. Character identity is locked; acting emotion may vary by scene.
global_rules: One stable provider voice ID per character once assigned; never silently substitute another voice.
Do not use the narrator voice for character dialogue unless the speaker is Arya narrating in first person.
Preserve age impression, gender presentation, accent, timbre, resonance, and speaking habits across episodes.
Change emotion, intensity, pacing, and breath according to the scene without changing the underlying voice identity.
If a provider voice ID is unavailable, stop and report the missing voice; do not pretend pitch/rate processing is an equivalent replacement.
Do not imitate or clone a real person's voice without their permission.

provider.limitation: Two base voices are insufficient for 20 genuinely distinct identities. The registry locks casting descriptions and keys, but provider-specific immutable voice IDs remain pending until a voice provider with sufficient distinct voices is connected and tested.
provider.voice_id_assignment_policy: After auditions are approved, save the exact provider voice ID per character and reuse it unchanged.

requirements: All narration and character dialogue must be spoken in natural Indonesian.
Use native-sounding Indonesian pronunciation and prosody; do not allow English accent carryover.
Test Indonesian diction, names, local terms, and conversational phrasing before approving each voice.
Reject any voice that cannot deliver clear, natural Indonesian even if its timbre matches the character.
Keep each approved provider voice ID fixed across all episodes.
language_policy.acceptance_gate: No character voice is approved or locked until an Indonesian-language audition is generated and reviewed.
